description:
Take full control of your OpenWrt router with LuCI Mobile. Our app offers a modern, intuitive interface to securely manage your home network from anywhere.
Designed for both power users and network enthusiasts, LuCI Mobile simplifies router management without sacrificing functionality.
Key Features:
• Multiple Router Management: Add, switch, and manage any number of OpenWrt routers. Each router’s data is kept separate and secure.
• Real-Time Dashboard: Instantly view system status, performance metrics, and uptime with interactive charts.
• Complete Network Management: Monitor all wired and wireless interfaces, track bandwidth usage, and check IP configurations.
• Detailed Client Oversight: See a live list of all connected devices with their IP/MAC addresses, hostnames, and active connection times.
• Powerful System Control: Remotely reboot your router with a single tap.
• Secure & Flexible Connection: Connect via HTTP or HTTPS, with support for self-signed certificates and secure credential storage.
• Modern UI: Enjoy a clean experience with Material Design 3, including full support for light and dark themes.
Requirements:
This app requires an OpenWrt router with the LuCI web interface enabled. For remote access, ensure your router's firewall is configured correctly.
Support & Source Code:
LuCI Mobile is an open-source project. For support, to report issues, or to view the source code, please visit our GitHub repository:
